signals: About 43,553 new single-family homes were permitted in the Houston metro in the 12 months to 2026-09 (-18% vs. five years earlier): new lawns every day.
Montgomery County grew +24.9% in five years to 781 thousand people (2025).
Liberty County grew +31.2% in five years to 121 thousand people (2025).
Harris County grew +6.6% in five years to 5,045 thousand people (2025).
The building-and-grounds services trade (which includes landscaping) employs 2,313 thousand people nationally, +6.7% in five years: steady growth, and steady competition for good crew.
The Houston metro has 3,494 thousand jobs, +12.4% in five years: more working households with less time for yard work.
Houston consumer prices rose +3.7% in the year to 2026-10; a price that stays flat is a real cut each year.
method: U.S. government data via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); robots.txt obeyed.
